newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgarian crisis talks end without agreement.
newsitem.headline: Bulgarian crisis talks end without agreement.

text.p: A meeting between Bulgaria's President Zhelyu Zhelev, security chiefs and leaders of major political parties ended on Saturday without agreement on how to defuse a deepening political crisis, an opposition leader said.

Yordan Sokolov, parliamentary leader of the Union of Democratic Forces, warned opposition leaders might no longer be able to control protesters who besieged parliament for 10 hours on Friday and resumed protests on Saturday.
"These are desperate people and it is hard to control their anger, but still we'll try to lead this protest and try to avoid violence," Sokolov said.
He said the UDF and Zhelev had proposed presenting to parliament on Monday a motion calling for general elections, but the Socialists refused.

At a rally outside parliament, UDF chairman Ivan Kostov called for daily protests until the Socialists agreed to the opposition's demand for general elections but urged the crowds to keep away from parliament.
Zhelev was expected to address the nation later in the afternoon.
